what: Slogan text on a thick wavy line flows endlessly along the line — start position 0% → −100% in one loop of 30s with no easing, pausing when the panel moves 20% beyond the top or bottom of the screen and resuming when it comes back. The text repeats on its own to more than twice the line length, so the line never goes empty even when pushed to the end

options.textPath: Text to flow — <text><textPath href="#Line id">Slogan</textPath></text>, only needs to be written once
options.[data-fx-part=line]: (If present) bold stroke path the text sits on — painted in the accent color
options.dir: When reverse is on, it runs the other way (−100% → 0%)
options.start · end: Flow range ScrollTrigger, default top 120% · bottom -20%
options.from · to: Start and end positions (startOffset), default 0% · -100% — to enter from outside the left of the path and exit fully, use from: -20%.; to: 100%
options.fill: If off, the text is not repeated to stretch it — a single piece of text passes along a long path

use: <svg data-fx="path-text-loop" viewBox="0 0 1440 300"><path id="wave" data-fx-part="line" d="…" stroke-width="56"/><text font-size="28" dominant-baseline="middle"><textPath href="#wave">HAVE A NICE DAY</textPath></text></svg>
note: Line width is set with the stroke-width attribute. If two ids are the same, href follows the first one, so give each line a different id

from.where: shared.js [data-ribbon] five text ribbons (original .svg-repeat textPath: startOffset 0%→−100%, --speed 30s, ease none, plays and pauses at start top 120% · end bottom -20%)

shared.js [data-roll] wave tape two rows (original Roll — each letter goes straight along MotionPath for 3x the path length over 80s (phone 35s), i.e. one path length in 26.7s (phone 11.7s) — speed 26.7, reverse row is dir: reverse · flows only while the panel is on screen)

index.html .cb-map__road — slogan text over a wide gray road (original SVG <animate attributeName=startOffset from -20% to 100% dur 30s repeatCount indefinite>, the panel keeps flowing even when off-screen)
